Alex W: Quick Q — I set up pre-tax HSA contributions via payroll. Can I still roll over funds from my old HSA custodian into the Redwood HSA? Also, do HSA contributions reduce the amount used to calculate 401(k) employer match?

Jackie (People Ops): Yes — you can roll over funds from a previous HSA into our SecureVest HSA. Rollover transfers are handled outside of regular payroll deferrals, so they don’t affect your 401(k) match. The employer match is computed based on your 401(k) deferrals and eligible pay only.

Ben R: For payroll/finance clarity — HSA pretax deductions use payroll code HSA-PRETAX and will show up as pre-tax deferrals. Rollover transfers should be submitted to SecureVest and we record them as HSA-ROLL (non-taxable transfer). We do NOT include HSA-PRETAX or HSA-ROLL amounts when computing the 401(k) match.

Jackie (People Ops): Short snippet of useful codes for your HR ticket if you need to file one:

```
HSA-PRETAX  # ongoing payroll deduction
HSA-ROLL    # one-time rollover transfer
401K-DEF    # employee 401(k) deferral code
```

Maria G: FYI open enrollment note — you can enroll or change HSA contribution elections during open enrollment (deadline Nov 30). Rollover transfers are separate and can be initiated any time, though vendor ACH windows are usually 7–14 business days. Link to portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/hsa

HR Bot: Automated message — SecureVest HSA added to benefits portal for Redwood employees. See portal for transfer instructions.

Alex W: Thanks — one follow-up: if I switch my 401(k) contributions from pre-tax to Roth mid-year, does that change match eligibility?

Jackie (People Ops): Good question. Our plan matches based on eligible deferrals, whether pre-tax or Roth — so switching to Roth does not make you ineligible for the employer match. The match itself is contributed to your 401(k) pre-tax account per plan rules (see summary plan description).

Ben R: If you plan to change contribution type mid-year, submit the payroll change by EOD Wednesday to take effect next pay period. If you want me to run an estimate of year-to-date vs projected match, DM me your current % and gross salary and I’ll calc it.

Alex W: Awesome, appreciate the quick answers :thumbsup:
